payload.model_selected: Model 1 — Master holds lock 900s TTL, agents do not heartbeat. TTL covers one 15-min scheduler cycle. Rationale: simpler than Model 2 (master release via agent signal), acceptable because cowork slots are time-bucketed — if agent stalls, next tick gets fresh lock key.
